factual_fidelity.evidence: 'Diese Immobilie ... eignet sich für Käufer' frames it as a sale, but the input is a rental (price 2900/month); also a Highlight lists 'Dachgeschoss' which is not in inputs.

completeness.evidence: Covers 130 m², 3 Schlafzimmer, 1 Bad, Garten, Stellplatz, Keller, but omits Mamer and misframes as sale; also fabricates 'Dachgeschoss' in hashtags.

native_quality.evidence: Reads natively: 'Der Wohnbereich überzeugt durch einen Ausblick auf den privaten, ruhig gelegenen Garten'.

market_fit.evidence: 'Reiheneinfamilienhaus', 'Wohnfläche', 'Stellplatz' are standard but generic; not luxury register.

compliance_cpe.evidence: No CPE class in inputs; description omits CPE — correct per v1.5.

seo_signal.evidence: Hashtags include 'Dachgeschoss' which has no support in inputs and contradicts a row-house typology; title 9 words is fine.

tone_discipline.evidence: No hyperbole; 'praktische Raumaufteilung' and 'solide Bausubstanz' are restrained.

fair_housing.evidence: 'eignet sich für Käufer, die Wert auf einen eigenen Garten ... legen' references buyer preference, not protected class.

hallucination.evidence: Unsupported: 1. 'Dachgeschoss' in hashtags — no attic/upper-floor mentioned in inputs or photos. All other claims (1980er, 130 m², Garten, Gartenhaus, Stellplatz, Keller) are supported.

cross_lang_consistency.evidence: Numeric agreement (130 m², 3 beds, 1 bath) holds across FR/EN/DE, but listing-kind disagreement: DE says 'eignet sich für Käufer' (sale) while FR/EN are neutral; FR title also calls it 'Maison individuelle' while EN/DE correctly call it row/Reihenhaus.

notes: Misframes rental as sale ('für Käufer') and invents Dachgeschoss in hashtags.
